reviewer.note: APPROVE on retry 1 after one REJECT (rejects: 1 of 3), conditional on the manual attestation that has since been given. The REJECT was a REAL CORRECTNESS DEFECT, not a style point: resetEnrollVoiceStep() cleared only the JS counter while the bridge's _enroll_voiceprints was cleared solely on a successful enroll(), so an abandoned run leaked takes -- bank 2, Cancel, re-open showed 0/5 while the engine held 2, the dots then jumped 0->3, sentences 2 and 3 were never read, and the vault would have been sealed from the two ABANDONED takes plus three new ones, binding the middle key partly to discarded audio (possibly a different speaker's) and reachable in the very manual demo. Fixed at the source by restoring BoothApi.reset_enroll_takes() -- this time with three call sites and two tests, exactly the condition the Task 3 verdict set when it deleted the speculative version -- and both call sites await it so the bridge is empty before a new take can bank. Second, minor finding (an enroll 'BRIDGE MISSING' branch made unreachable by this same diff) also fixed. Reviewer confirmed the headline requirement: auth_outer and auth_voice route to separate chips, statuses and prompts, and the old catch-all fallthrough that rendered 'Wrong passphrase' for EVERY error is gone -- before this task the live Booth could not demo the feature at all.
